name: superflat-passive-census
about: [проверить] Run on fresh isolated 26.1.2 flat saves. Spectator enters a fresh area with spawning enabled: initial animals must be zero (no chunk-generation herds). Then create a common elevated grass pad and count periodic plains animals at 400-tick intervals. Counts are statistical; repeat on fresh areas/seeds. Pad height is deliberately identical because our flat ground is Y=0, vanilla Y=-61. Scoreboard text is the authoritative count, including animals outside tracker range. Requires no other non-spectator players; restore previous gamerules manually if different.

actions.cmd: gamerule spawn_mobs true
scoreboard players set #initial flat_animals 0
execute as @e[type=sheep,distance=..192] run scoreboard players add #initial flat_animals 1
execute as @e[type=pig,distance=..192] run scoreboard players add #initial flat_animals 1
execute as @e[type=chicken,distance=..192] run scoreboard players add #initial flat_animals 1
execute as @e[type=cow,distance=..192] run scoreboard players add #initial flat_animals 1
execute as @e[type=horse,distance=..192] run scoreboard players add #initial flat_animals 1
execute as @e[type=donkey,distance=..192] run scoreboard players add #initial flat_animals 1
scoreboard players get #initial flat_animals
gamerule spawn_mobs false
kill @e[type=sheep,distance=..192]
kill @e[type=pig,distance=..192]
kill @e[type=chicken,distance=..192]
kill @e[type=cow,distance=..192]
